decision.primary_endpoint: responsive PertRank minus Euclidean, five groups averaged within query
decision.confirmation_rule: no allzero PertRank input group AND point >=0.01 AND lower nominal two-sided 95% paired query-block percentile bound >0
decision.improvement_rule: no allzero PertRank input group AND point >=0.02 AND the same lower95 bound >0
decision.closed_gate_rule: all contrasts still reported descriptively; neither raw comparisons, terciles nor cell equivalents rescue a failed primary gate

responsive.scope: conditional on realized100-cell reservoir, fixed controls, queries, candidate pool and reference; nested/overlapping anchors are not independent experiments; no sequencing-cost claim

paired_metric_equivalent_depth_differenc.definition: paired finite difference when both crossings are identifiable; each other draw retained as interval[-infinity,+infinity], not discarded

responsive.role: prespecified secondary estimation; cannot rescue primary failure
responsive.interpretation: ranking-input equivalent depth conditional on this 100-cell reservoir; not total experimental cost saving
responsive.interpolation_caveat: piecewise linear inverse may overestimate equivalent depth on a concave curve; no smoothing or extrapolation
